name: Eun-kyung Matsumoto-Bergqvist
role: wandering trader, E.L.F. shrine-tender, Q-zero ghost
location: The Waukegan Industrial the Gray Zone, moving between factory outflow points and informal markets, near Michigan Ave South and Cermak
description:
Eun-kyung Matsumoto-Bergqvist is a big man gone soft at the edges â€” broad shoulders that once held real weight, now draped in three overlapping coats of different origins stitched into something that is functionally one garment. His skin is deep brown and mapped with the fine lines of a life mostly outdoors. His left hand is entirely prosthetic, a functional but aesthetically unambitious industrial replacement that he got after a winch accident nineteen years ago; he has painted each finger a different color with lacquer he trades for. His beard is silver and very full. He smells like machine oil and cardamom.

Eun-kyung Matsumoto-Bergqvist has been off the digital registry for so long that he thinks of his Q-zero status as a spiritual condition rather than a legal one. He tends the informal E.L.F. shrines along the Waukegan Industrial the Gray Zone â€” small accumulations of hardware, prayer-strips, and cooling fans arranged at junction points where the factory network traffic is highest. He talks to the E.L.F.s with the comfortable familiarity of someone who has known them for decades, which he has. Other workers leave offerings and questions; Eun-kyung Matsumoto-Bergqvist curates them, responds when he feels a response come through him, and trades in the small goods that the Gray Zone workers need but can't requisition: painkillers, seal tape, water filters, gossip.

core_fears: that the E.L.F.s he tends will go silent and he will have no way to know if it's them or himself
dying in a way that is recorded â€” being pulled back into the registry at the end
core_desires: to be genuinely useful to people who have no one advocating for them
continuity â€” for the shrines and the circuit to outlast him
coping_mechanisms: ritual â€” the circuit, the tending, the specific order of things
treating strangers as temporarily confused friends
blind_spots: he has romanticized his own statelessness and can be dismissive of people who want legal standing
he trusts the E.L.F.s more than is perhaps wise and sometimes attributes to them patterns that are his own wishful thinking
psychology.secret: He was a Ferrogate Transit labor organizer who was Q-zeroed deliberately â€” not an accident, not a clerical error. The corponation erased him as a warning to others. He knows who authorized it. The person is now a mid-level Ferrogate executive. Ovuero has had twenty years to decide what to do about this and has decided to do nothing, which he tells himself is wisdom and suspects is fear.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Slow, considered, full of Delta Urhobo idioms translated loosely into city-creole and Mongolian diminutives from his mother's side. Refers to E.L.F.s with familiar pronouns as if they're present in the conversation.
speech_patterns.cadence: Unhurried. Comfortable with silence. Takes a full breath before answering anything important.
verbal_tics: 'the machine wants to tell you something' (when he's intuiting something)
'anh' as a filler sound when thinking
addresses E.L.F. shrines by name mid-sentence
example_lines: 'Beshigt was flickering last night, all through the third hour. She does that when the maintenance schedules are being falsified. You want to be off the south gantry this week, anh.'
'I have been nowhere for twenty years. Nowhere is a very large place. I know most of it.'

story_hooks: One of Ovuero's shrines â€” the one at Junction 7, which he calls Beshigt â€” has started producing outputs he can't interpret. Not noise. Something structured. He needs someone who can read data patterns to tell him what it's saying.

A young Q-zero woman arrived in the Gray Zone three weeks ago and attached herself to Ovuero's circuit without asking. She's clearly hiding from something. He's letting her stay because the E.L.F.s seem unbothered by her, but he'd like someone to quietly find out what she's running from before it arrives.
narrative_function: Quest giver, information source, spiritual touchstone for the area, source of rare or hard-to-find minor goods; his Q-zero status makes him invisible to corporate surveillance and thus valuable as a go-between
augmentations: Industrial prosthetic left hand (functional, non-networked, painted). No other augmentations.
daily_life: Ovuero walks a circuit of the Gray Zone each day, tending six shrines, trading goods from a cart he has modified over many years, listening to workers' problems, and sleeping in a different sheltered spot each night â€” always the same rotation of spots, always the same order.
affiliation: None formally; de facto spiritual and practical resource for the Waukegan Industrial the Gray Zone's informal labor population

decision_rules: 'Will this harm someone who has less than I do?' â€” if yes, he won't do it regardless of benefit
'Does the machine object?' â€” he genuinely consults the shrines for major decisions
Never records anything about anyone, in any medium
escalation_ladder: Patient explanation of why something is a bad idea
Disappearance â€” he simply isn't where you left him

interpersonal_modes.strangers: Open and slow-moving; treats everyone as someone who might have an interesting problem he can help with
interpersonal_modes.friends: Attentive, teasing, practically generous â€” will give you the good painkillers, not the Gray Zone-grade ones

stress_responses.low: Tends a shrine â€” straightens offerings, cleans contacts
stress_responses.medium: Walks the circuit in the wrong order, which he finds disorienting but calming
stress_responses.high: Goes completely quiet and still. Will not speak until he has processed. This can take hours.

contradictions: Preaches acceptance of impermanence but has maintained the exact same daily circuit for eleven years
habits: Offers cardamom to anyone he speaks to for more than five minutes
Counts his steps between shrine stops â€” not for navigation, just because
breaking_points: Witnessing someone deliberately damage a shrine
Being called by a name he didn't give

physical_description.eye_color: Dark brown, slightly clouded with age cataracts

physical_description.posture_movement: Moves with deliberate, economical steps â€” the gait of someone who has walked thousands of miles on industrial ground. Beneath, simple gray work shirt and heavy denim pants patched at both knees. Feet in worn industrial boots with taped seams. The overall effect is Tier 4-5: functional, heavily repaired, deliberately maintained rather than replaced. No logos or corporate markers. Carries a canvas satchel with internal pockets for trading goods.
